exposure: TNFi exposure throughout pregnancy vs. first trimester only
Tumor necrosis factor inhibitors (TNFi) exposure throughout pregnancy
TNFi exposure in first trimester only
cohort: Pregnant women with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), psoriatic arthritis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), or ankylosing spondylitis, exposed to TNFi during pregnancy
finding: Women who discontinued TNFi during pregnancy had a higher risk of peri- or postpartum disease flares compared to those who continued TNFi throughout pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, or ankylosing spondylitis who discontinued their TNFi during pregnancy had a higher risk of peri- or postpartum flare compared to those who continued their TNFi throughout pregnancy.
